Hate Speech Detection Using Classical Machine Learning and Transformer-Based Models
The identification of hate speech and offensive speech in code-mixed texts, especially Hinglish (a mix of Hindi and English), is a highly challenging task with the inherent linguistic characteristics and colloquial nature of such texts. This paper explores the performance of state-of-the-art deep learning models, BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) and MuRIL (Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages), in overcoming the challenges.
